import re

filepath = r"D:\Claude Code+DeepSeekV4\city-life-story\src\js\ui\render.js"

with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    content = f.read()

# Fix 1: Add parent.innerHTML = "" to renderInventoryTab

new_inv = "function renderInventoryTab(state, parent) {\n  parent.innerHTML = \"\";\n  const div = document.createElement(\"div\");"

new_skill = "function renderSkillsTab(state, parent) {\n  parent.innerHTML = \"\";\n  const div = document.createElement(\"div\");"

new_append = "  parent.appendChild(div);\n  console.log(\"Skills tab rendered\");\n}\n\n// ====== Corp Tab"
content = content.replace(old_append, new_append, 1)

with open(filepath, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(content)

print("  3. console.log(\"Skills tab rendered\") after appendChild in renderSkillsTab")
